summary: Language layer regression + feature test (iteration 8). Full backend pytest suite now 84 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing TestDeliveryEndToEnd geocoding skip, unchanged from iters 2-7). All email signature changes (lang='nl' default + call sites passing restaurant.defaultLanguage) are backward-compatible: no regressions in order creation, status transitions, email-toggle independence, token hashing/expiry, tenant isolation, uploads, or admin order deletion. New focused suite /app/backend/tests/test_language_defaults.py (3/3 passed) verifies: (a) POST /api/admin/restaurants creates restaurants with defaultLanguage='en' while seeded bistro-demo stays 'nl'; (b) GET /api/public/order-status/<token> and GET /api/public/orders/<id> both include a 'language' field matching the restaurant's defaultLanguage; (c) PUT /api/restaurant/profile persists defaultLanguage server-side, GET /api/restaurant/me reflects it, and placing a public order after the switch yields status payload with the new language. Playwright (desktop 1920x1080) end-to-end: logged in as owner@demo.upxero.com, Dutch sidebar labels present (Overzicht, Bestellingen, Categorieën, Bezorging, Openingstijden, Profiel, Uitloggen); switched Profile language select (data-testid='profile-language-select') to English, saved via profile-save-button, reloaded, sidebar switched to Overview/Orders/Categories/Delivery/Opening hours/Profile/Log out. Placed public order; /order-status/<token> rendered English (Awaiting confirmation, Pickup, Subtotal, Total, 'Your order has been received and is awaiting confirmation from the restaurant.', timeline labels Confirmed/Preparing/Ready for pickup/Completed) and /order/bistro-demo/bevestiging/<id> rendered 'Order confirmed!'  with 'Thank you T. Bistro Demo has received your order.' and 'Payment on pickup.' Restaurant-owned content (name 'Bistro Demo', item 'Classic Cheeseburger') remained untranslated — correct. Switched back to Nederlands, sidebar reverted to Dutch, and a fresh public order's status page rendered 'Wacht op bevestiging / Afhalen / Subtotaal / Totaal' and confirmation 'Bestelling bevestigd!'. Demo baseline reset: bistro-demo defaultLanguage == 'nl' at end of run (confirmed via public endpoint).
critical_code_review_comments: services/email.py: ET dict keeps restaurant-owned content (names, item names, addresses, options) outside the translation table — only chrome strings are translated. _L() clamps to {'en','nl'} with a safe fallback. All send_* functions preserve default lang='nl' so any legacy caller is unaffected.

routers/public.py: _public_restaurant exposes defaultLanguage. _public_order_view and public_order_confirmation both emit 'language' derived from the restaurant (defaulting to 'en' only when the restaurant was deleted — acceptable for a dangling-order view). Checkout path forwards _lang into both restaurant and customer emails.

routers/orders.py: _notify_customer passes restaurant.defaultLanguage into send_order_status_customer_email/send_order_eta_customer_email — covered by TestWorkflow and TestEmailToggleIndependence regression (both green).

routers/admin.py + routers/auth.py: new restaurants get defaultLanguage='en'. Seeded demo untouched (seed.py preserves 'nl'). Verified end-to-end by test_new_restaurant_defaults_to_english_and_demo_stays_dutch.

lib/i18n.js uses Dutch strings as keys which guarantees byte-identical Dutch rendering; EN is a lookup; unconverted strings safely fall back to Dutch — matches the main-agent's note about Order checkout and dashboard management pages intentionally rendering Dutch in English mode. Not reported as bugs.
lib/constants.js statusLabel(status, lang) is small, pure, and correctly covers all six statuses in both languages.

Still-Dutch surfaces when restaurant.defaultLanguage='en' (expected per request, not bugs): OrderPage checkout, dashboard pages (Orders, Categories, MenuItems, Delivery, OpeningHours, Staff, Overview, AdminRestaurants), auth pages (Login/Register/Forgot/Reset/StaffInvitation/Landing).
P3 hardening (unchanged from iter 7, not blocking): consider docs_url=None, openapi_url=None in production.

seed_data_creation: Transient: (1) one TEST_LangDefault_<hex> restaurant was created via POST /api/admin/restaurants and immediately DELETE'd by the backend test; (2) a few public orders on bistro-demo were created during the frontend Playwright run (idempotent, no cleanup needed — they are regular order history). Demo bistro-demo defaultLanguage was briefly toggled to 'en' during the UI switch test and reset to 'nl' at the end — confirmed via public endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full regression + language suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v (needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported from /app/frontend/.env). 84 passed, 1 skipped. The Profile save button is data-testid='profile-save-button' (NOT type='submit'). Language select is data-testid='profile-language-select' with values 'en'/'nl'. Public payloads: GET /api/public/restaurant/<slug> → restaurant.defaultLanguage ; GET /api/public/order-status/<token> and GET /api/public/orders/<id> → top-level 'language' field. Switching restaurant language affects FUTURE orders' status/confirmation copy and future emails; existing orders keep rendering per the restaurant's current language (correct — status page reads live). Unconverted dashboard/checkout/auth surfaces still show Dutch strings in English mode by design; the main agent will convert these in later iterations.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Email signature change is backward-compatible via default 'nl' param. Dutch rendering is byte-identical because the i18n map uses Dutch strings as keys. New restaurants correctly default to English; demo stays Dutch; Profile persists defaultLanguage via the standard /restaurant/profile PUT body.
